From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orioncloud.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding + PO routing for Redwood listing

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the intro over the phone earlier. We are ready to start the vendor onboarding process so Redwood can be listed as a seller in our account and (eventually) enabled on AWS Marketplace for procurement. To get going I have a couple of asks:

- Can you share your standard vendor intake packet (W-9, tax info, bank wiring instructions, and any reseller paperwork)?
- We need to confirm the PO routing options for three channels: direct invoice (Redwood invoice -> OrionCloud AP), AWS Marketplace (3rd-party procurement flow), and our internal Marketplace procurement broker. Each has slightly different PO and invoicing requirements.
- Do you have a seller-facing checklist for marketplace onboarding (e.g., required metadata, product SKUs, listing docs)?

Our timeline is to complete intake paperwork and have a PO lane identified by EOW (next Friday). 

I can take the intake forms and loop in our AP lead (procurement@orioncloud.com). If it helps, we can schedule a quick 20-minute session with procurement/IT next week to walk through marketplace routing.

Thanks — attaching a short vendor checklist on our side.

Best,
Elena Soto
Sr. Procurement Manager
OrionCloud
Phone: +1 415-555-0134

Attachments: orion_vendor_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orioncloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + PO routing for Redwood listing

Hi Elena — great to connect earlier. Thanks for the clear list. I attached our vendor intake packet and a short doc that maps the three PO routing options and the documentation each lane requires. Quick summary here: 

- Direct invoice: Standard PO -> Redwood invoices to AP@redwood.com. We send PDF invoice monthly or on agreed milestone. Required items: PO number, billing contact, remit address (included in packet).
- AWS Marketplace (3P): Works as a third-party purchase. We list the SKU; AWS processes funds and remits to Redwood. Procurement needs the AWS seller ID and a Marketplace Partner Agreement. We can start the seller registration in parallel; onboarding typically takes ~2-3 weeks for basic listing.
- Internal procurement broker: If Orion uses a broker, we need the broker's vendor ID and any tax exemptions. Times vary by broker.

Next steps I propose:
1) I attached the redwood_vendor_intake.pdf (includes W-9 placeholder). Please fill out company billing details and return.
2) If you want AWS Marketplace, indicate "3P" in the intake and I will route to Marketplace Onboarding to start seller registration.
3) If you already have a PO number, reply with it and we will map the routing.

Would Tuesday 12/2 at 10:00 PT work for a quick sync with procurement? If so I will send a calendar invite and include Vanessa (billing) and Ben (marketplace ops).

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_vendor_intake.pdf (form stub), redwood_vendor_instructions.pdf (short guidance)
